Class SimpleBoard

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.model.SimpleBoard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Board
public class SimpleBoard extends Object implements Board
A simple implementation of the Game Board interface.

Manages the game state including the active brick, held brick, next brick queue, score, and board matrix operations.

/** A concrete implementation of the Tetris game board.

This class manages all core game mechanics including:

  • Board state and collision detection
  • Brick movement and rotation
  • Next piece queue management (3 pieces)
  • Hold piece functionality
  • Row clearing and scoring
  • Game state management

The board maintains a queue of 3 upcoming bricks, supports hold functionality with turn-based restrictions, and provides comprehensive view data for the UI.

    • createNewBrick

      public boolean createNewBrick()
      Creates and spawns a new brick on the board.

      This method manages the brick queue by removing the first brick from the next bricks queue and adding a newly generated brick to maintain the queue size. The new brick is positioned at the top center of the board.

      Collision detection is performed to check if the new brick can spawn without overlapping existing bricks. If a collision occurs, this indicates game over.

      After successfully spawning a new brick, the hold functionality is reset to allow the player to hold this new piece.

      Specified by:
      createNewBrick in interface Board
      Returns:
      true if the new brick spawned with a collision (game over); false if the brick spawned successfully without collision

    • mergeBrickToBackground

      public void mergeBrickToBackground()
      Merges the currently active brick into the game board matrix. *

      mergeBrickToBackground() is called when the active brick can no longer move .The brick's shape matrix is merged with the current game matrix, making it a permanent part of the board state.

      Specified by:

    • clearRows

      public ClearRow clearRows()
      Checks for and clears any completed rows on the board.

      clearRows() scans the entire board matrix for rows that are completely filled with bricks. Completed rows are removed, and all rows above are shifted down to fill the gaps. Empty rows are added at the top.

      Specified by:
      clearRows in interface Board
      Returns:
      a ClearRow object containing the new board matrix and clearing information

    • holdBrick

      public void holdBrick()
      Hold the current active brick. If no brick held yet -> store current and spawn next. If a brick is held -> swap held with current. Holding twice in same turn is prevented.
